title: Client Telemetry for Pub/Sub Publish Operations
summary: Cloud Pub/Sub introduces new schemas, `PublishOperation` and `PubsubClientTelemetry`, to provide more detailed client-side telemetry for publish operations, including hedging attempts and client-side start times.
details: The `pubsub.v1beta2` API now includes two new schemas. `PubsubClientTelemetry` is introduced to capture client-side telemetry, intended to be passed via the `x-goog-pubsub-client-telemetry` header. This schema includes a `publishOperation` field, which references the new `PublishOperation` schema. The `PublishOperation` schema itself now exposes `hedgedAttemptCount` (an integer indicating hedging attempts) and `publishStartTime` (a timestamp for the client-side initiation of the publish call), offering deeper insights into client-side publish behavior and performance.
